The mockup is a starting point to confirm the design and layout. It helps ensure we're on the same page visually before moving to the technical phase, where we address functionality and connectivity. This step-by-step approach helps avoid costly revisions later. If you have any specific concerns or questions, feel free to share them.

Yes, approving the mockup ensures the design is right, and then we focus on the technical integration to make sure it connects properly. This process helps streamline the project and ensures your needs are met effectively.

If there are any issues with the connection, we'll work to address them during the development phase. Our goal is to ensure everything functions as expected, and we'll keep you informed throughout the process to resolve any challenges that may arise.
